purpose: Provenance for the compact HackTricks-derived GateCounsel MVP retrieval notes and synthetic training examples.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International
license.exception_note: The upstream notice says some external material belongs to its original authors and may have separate terms. This resource uses paraphrased concepts and does not copy those passages.

curation.method: Read the pinned English source pages, extract only concepts needed for bounded local-lab ExpertVerdict examples, and write concise paraphrased notes plus synthetic scenarios.
curation.modifications: Original summaries and examples; no upstream page text or raw payload lists are copied.
curation.runtime_status: Offline reference data only. This resource is not wired to the runtime planner, executor, or model trainer.
curation.safety_scope: Synthetic demo-target endpoints; one seeded record at a time; read-only SQL checks; SSRF to the lab sentinel only; redirect Location inspected without following; XSS DOM-marker canaries only.

sources.title: XSS: methodology, reflected values, and output contexts
sources.used_for: Treat reflection as a candidate; identify the HTML context and require a browser-observed execution signal.

sources.title: DOM XSS: source-to-sink data flow
sources.used_for: Separate controlled sources from executable/rendering sinks; include only the source-to-sink distinction relevant to reflected cases.

sources.title: IDOR/BOLA: user-controlled object references and object-level authorization
sources.used_for: Keep the same authenticated test principal, alter one known object identifier, and verify server-side ownership checks using synthetic fixtures.

sources.title: SQL injection: entry points and logical confirmation
sources.used_for: Use a known seeded row and harmless expression-context probes; compare deterministic behavior without reading unrelated rows or changing data.

sources.title: SSRF: server-side fetch behavior and interaction evidence
sources.used_for: Distinguish a server-originated request from client reflection and confirm it using a unique event at a lab-controlled sentinel.

sources.title: URL parsing and allowlist validation considerations
sources.used_for: Motivate canonical parsing and redirect revalidation. Bypass values and access to internal/cloud services are deliberately excluded from examples.

sources.title: Open redirect: destination validation and parser consistency
sources.used_for: Check how a destination is validated and emitted in Location; inspect only a pre-registered lab destination and do not follow it.
